detail.compatibility_rule: IPv4 /24 and IPv6 /48; X->Y->X inside the window is one conflict
detail.domain_offered: same lab /24 and same origin /24; trusted-proxy X-Forwarded-For is not the clone's TCP peer
detail.gap: ENR-07 / devstack follow-up 14: the lab has no second /24 for the clone. StartClonedIdentityFixture(ctx, "node") attaches node-clone to the same lab bridge and the same origin bridge (last octet .23). The agent mTLS path is the local resolver proxy to agent.example.invalid:9443, whose TCP peer is that lab address, not trusted gateway 172.28.38.21/32, so X-Forwarded-For is not the compatibility domain. Interleave, conflict freeze, revokeNode plus re-enroll, and the quiet-window promotion were not run.
